posts.title: Debunking zswap and zram myths
posts.description: tl;dr: If in doubt, prefer to use zswap. Only use zram if you have a highly specific reason to. In terms of architecture: zswap sits in front of your disk swap, compresses pages in RAM, and automatically tiers cold data to disk.
